title: Extension by zero is exact and preserves punctual weights
statement:
Let $j:U_0\hookrightarrow X_0$ be an open immersion of separated finite-type schemes over a finite field. For constructible $\Qlb$-Weil sheaves, extension by zero $j_!$ is exact. At a geometric point of $U_0$ its stalk is the original stalk with its local Frobenius, and at a geometric point of the complement its stalk is zero. Consequently $j_!$ preserves punctual upper weight bounds and punctual purity.
Here open immersion and constructible Weil sheaf conventions are [def-weil-open-immersion], [def-weil-constructible-heart], and [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], with weights as in [def-weil-punctual-weights].
